prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a polished website portfolio card cover for Algo-Vis, an editor plugin that visualizes algorithms in VS Code and Obsidian. Generate a brand new wide 16:9 illustration. The project must be immediately recognizable as algorithm visualization: a bright silver and warm ivory computing workspace with a large clear code editor panel and a large algorithm animation panel. At the center, five substantial mint-green numbered tiles show the sequence 6, 2, 9, 1, 5; the first two tiles are highlighted warm amber, with two clean curved arrows showing their exchange. Behind them, a crisp increasing bar chart and a small tree/branch diagram communicate sorting and step-by-step logic. The editor shows a few sparse, high-contrast syntax-colored code lines with one highlighted row, no dense fake text. Refined 3D editorial illustration with tactile glass and brushed-silver surfaces, soft daylight, cream and sage-green palette, generous light backgrounds, gentle grounded shadows. Bright and readable at small card sizes; strong shapes and obvious compare/swap/code relationships. Full composition occupies the canvas without a dark surrounding void. No people or characters, no Firefly mascot, no purple/black background, no fantasy scenery, no decorative communication frame, no lens flare, no heavy bloom, no logos, no watermark. Only the five large digits need to be legible; no headings or slogans.
